name: ledgerglass-starter
description: Deploy-your-own evidence-aware personal finance MCP for Cloudflare Workers and SimpleFIN.

scripts.worker:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.worker:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.site:dry-run: npm run site:build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/site-dry-run --config site/wrangler.toml
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:build && wrangler deploy --config site/wrangler.toml
scripts.check: npm run privacy:audit && npm run showcase:validate && npm run typecheck && npm run worker:typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run site:check && npm run site:dry-run && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run worker:migrate:local && npm run worker:dry-run
